title: Implement NATS/JetStream client wrapper (pkg/events)
description: Real NATS/JetStream publish/subscribe client wrapping digital.vasic.eventbus/pkg/nats, providing the control-plane messaging backbone every service depends on. Must support JetStream stream administration (HELIX_NODES, HELIX_SESSIONS, HELIX_SCHEDULER, HELIX_HEALTH, HELIX_ALERTS) with subject convention {domain}.{entity_id}.{action}.
closure_criteria: Boot a real NATS+JetStream container via brokertest StartNATS; publish a NodeEvent on subject nodes.<uuid>.heartbeat and assert a subscriber receives the identical payload within the round-trip window; capture the broker stream-info log and the per-run UUID of the published message as sink-side evidence.

title: Implement etcd client wrapper (pkg/etcd)
description: Real go.etcd.io/etcd/client/v3 wrapper with concurrency primitives backing the discovery backend and distributed locks. Must expose the /clusteros key namespace (nodes/, sessions/, scheduler/, security/, config/, locks/) and the key-builder constants (NodeKey, SessionKey, SchedulerPoolKey, LockSchedulerKey).
closure_criteria: Boot a real etcd container via brokertest StartEtcd; Put a node descriptor under /clusteros/nodes/<uuid>, Get it back from a second client, and assert byte-equality; capture etcd revision number before/after and the per-run UUID as sink-side evidence.

title: Implement etcd discovery backend (pkg/discovery)
description: Service registry backed by etcd with lease + keepalive + put/delete on the clientv3 interface, providing TTL-bounded registration with pluggable backends consumed by the API gateway and scheduler.
closure_criteria: Register a service with a lease against real etcd; observe the keepalive renewing the lease; stop keepalive and assert the key disappears within TTL via a watching client; capture the lease-id and expiry timestamps with per-run UUID.

title: Implement real Kafka producer/consumer (pkg/pubsub)
description: Replace the in-memory map-of-channels Broker with a real Kafka client (segmentio/kafka-go or franz-go) implementing Publish(topic,key,value) and Subscribe(topic,group) with at-least-once delivery, idempotent acks=all producer, and offset commit. Keep in-memory impl behind the same interface for unit tests. Backs helix.audit.events and the event-stream topics.
closure_criteria: Against a real Kafka broker, publish N keyed messages, consume across 2 consumer-group members, and assert every key is delivered exactly to one consumer; capture consumer-group offset-commit log lines and per-run UUID. Mutation: skipping offset commit must break the no-redelivery assertion.

title: Implement cgroups v2 + /proc resource reader (pkg/resources)
description: Real cgroup-v2 filesystem parsing and /proc reader aggregating CPU/memory (and GPU) availability, feeding the scheduler with real resource data. Includes golden testdata for cgroup-v2 files.
closure_criteria: Parse a fixture cgroup-v2 tree and /proc snapshot, assert reported millicores and memory bytes match the golden values; on a real Linux host read live /proc and emit a ResourceSnapshot whose memory total matches `free -b`; capture the snapshot JSON with per-run UUID.

title: Implement Omega-model scheduler core (pkg/scheduler, internal/scheduler)
description: Shared-state Omega scheduler with filter/score/bind pipeline, optimistic-concurrency versioning over the etcd resource pool revision, cost-aware GPU placement, and gang scheduling with preemption. Job placement is an MVP blocker.
closure_criteria: Submit 10 ScheduleRequests with ClassAds requirements; assert each lands on a node satisfying CPU/mem/GPU constraints and that a stale-revision bind is rejected and retried; capture the binding records (session->node) and decision latency per request with per-run UUID.

title: Implement optimistic-concurrency versioning for scheduler pool
description: ScheduleOptimistic path with monotonic pool revision counter (scheduler/pool/revision) so concurrent binders detect conflicts and retry, preventing double-allocation under concurrent submissions.
closure_criteria: Run two concurrent binders racing for the last GPU; assert exactly one succeeds and the loser retries against the bumped revision; capture both revision values before/after and the conflict-retry log with per-run UUID.

title: Implement HTCondor ClassAds matching in scheduler (pkg/classads)
description: ClassAds expression evaluator supporting bilateral requirements/rank matching (e.g. TARGET.CPU >= 4000) used by the scheduler to match workload requirements against node advertisements.
closure_criteria: Evaluate a requirements expression against a set of node ClassAds; assert only matching nodes pass the filter and rank ordering matches the rank expression; capture the matched-node list and computed ranks with per-run UUID.

title: Implement gang scheduling and preemption in scheduler
description: Gang scheduling (all-or-nothing co-placement of a job group) and priority-based preemption so higher-priority work can evict lower-priority sessions per the cost_gpu/gang_preempt logic.
closure_criteria: Submit a gang requiring N slots when only N-1 free; assert no partial placement; then submit a high-priority job and assert a lower-priority session is preempted and rescheduled; capture preemption event and resulting bindings with per-run UUID.

title: Upgrade tmux backend to control-mode (-CC) with streaming I/O (pkg/session)
description: Upgrade the tmux backend Attach to tmux control mode (-CC), parsing %output/%begin/%end notifications into structured events so the session service can multiplex panes and forward PTY bytes. Current impl only shells to tmux for create/attach without control-mode or byte forwarding.
closure_criteria: Create a session, send a command, and assert a parsed %output event contains the command's stdout; capture the structured event log with the command output and per-run UUID. Mutation: ignoring %output frames must fail the assertion.

title: Implement CRDT session state and lifecycle (create/attach/migrate)
description: CRDT-backed distributed session state with lifecycle operations (CREATING->RUNNING->MIGRATING->PAUSED->TERMINATED), windows/panes model, and routing table. Provides the backend-agnostic SessionBackend contract.
closure_criteria: Create a session via SessionService.CreateSession, mutate window/pane CRDT state on two nodes concurrently, and assert both converge to the same document; capture the merged CRDT state and lifecycle transitions with per-run UUID.

title: Implement real Node gRPC handlers serving helixv1 Node API (internal/node)
description: gRPC server serving the generated helixv1 NodeService (Join, Heartbeat, Leave, GetNode, ListNodes, WatchNodes) wiring SWIM+WireGuard and the resource probe so nodes register and report resources.
closure_criteria: Start helix-node, call Join then Heartbeat with a health score and resource usage; assert GetNode reflects the reported resources and a WatchNodes stream emits a JOINED event; capture the gRPC responses and emitted event with per-run UUID.

title: Make node registry etcd-backed and cross-process shared (internal/node)
description: Persist RegisterNode/UpdateNodeStatus into pkg/etcd with lease-bound keys (TTL = heartbeat window) and read ListNodes from etcd so two helix-node processes see each other, replacing the process-local in-memory map lost on restart.
closure_criteria: Register on instance A; ListNodes on instance B returns it; stop A's keepalive and assert A's entry expires within TTL on B; capture B's node list before/after expiry with per-run UUID. Mutation: never attaching the lease must break the expiry assertion.

title: Implement SWIM gossip membership and failure detection (pkg/swim)
description: SWIM gossip over real UDP transport with suspicion mechanism, phi-accrual failure detection, and prober, driving node lifecycle JOINING->ACTIVE->SUSPECT->FAILED.
closure_criteria: Form a two-node SWIM group over real UDP; kill one node's process and assert the survivor marks it SUSPECT then FAILED within the configured window (<5s exit gate); capture the survivor's membership-state transition log with per-run UUID.

title: Implement WireGuard mesh config-gen and key rotation (pkg/wireguard)
description: WireGuard mesh peer config generation and key rotation producing valid peer configs (pubkey, allowed_ips) for the encrypted inter-node mesh on UDP 51820.
closure_criteria: Generate mesh configs for 3 peers; bring up real wg interfaces in a netns topology and assert peer-to-peer ICMP succeeds; rotate a key and assert connectivity re-establishes; capture wg show handshake timestamps with per-run UUID.

title: Implement WireGuard NAT traversal / STUN hole-punch (pkg/wireguard)
description: Replace the placeholder STUN-like nat_traversal.go with a real STUN client and UDP hole-punching so nodes behind NAT join the full mesh, with STUN/TURN relay fallback and hole-punch timeout.
closure_criteria: Across a multi-host NAT topology with a STUN/TURN relay, two NATed nodes establish a direct WireGuard tunnel via hole-punch; assert end-to-end mesh packet delivery; capture discovered external endpoints and handshake with per-run UUID.

title: Wire API gateway reverse proxy with prefix routing and /health (internal/gateway)
description: Reverse proxy with prefix routing to downstream services, /health endpoint, and graceful shutdown as the external ingress for CLI and Web UI.
closure_criteria: Start helix-gateway with a registered backend; issue a request to /api/v1/scheduler/ and assert it is proxied to the scheduler returning its response; hit /health and assert 200; capture proxied request/response pair with per-run UUID.

title: Add JWT/RBAC auth middleware to API gateway (internal/gateway)
description: Wrap the reverse-proxy handler with pkg/middleware + pkg/jwt: reject requests lacking a valid Bearer token (401), inject verified claims, and enforce internal/security scopes per route prefix. Currently no auth is wired despite pkg/jwt and pkg/middleware existing.
closure_criteria: Request /api/v1/scheduler/ with no/invalid/expired token returns 401; valid token with correct scope is proxied and returns 200; capture the 401 and 200 response codes with the decoded claim subject and per-run UUID. Mutation: making the verifier always return nil error must flip the unauthorized cases to passing.

title: Implement leader election with fencing tokens (pkg/leader)
description: Distributed leader election with lease registry, fencing tokens, epoch counter, and staleness detection with TTL failover for all control-plane services.
closure_criteria: Elect a leader among 3 candidates; kill the leader and assert a new leader is elected with a higher epoch/fencing token; assert a stale write carrying the old fencing token is rejected; capture both fencing tokens and the rejection with per-run UUID.

title: Implement distributed lock primitives over etcd (pkg/lock)
description: etcd-backed distributed lock for critical sections (scheduler mutex, per-session migration lock, config change lock).
closure_criteria: Two processes contend for the same lock key on real etcd; assert mutual exclusion (only one holds at a time) and that lock release unblocks the waiter; capture lock-acquire/release ordering with per-run UUID.

title: Implement Postgres-backed internal artifact registry (pkg/hxcregistry)
description: Internal image/artifact registry client backed by Postgres with schema.sql, used by the node agent and build service for content-addressed artifacts.
closure_criteria: Against a real Postgres container, register an artifact (name, sha256, size), look it up by content hash, and assert the stored row matches; capture the inserted row and CAS lookup result with per-run UUID.

title: Implement GPU resource probe with /proc parser (internal/gpu)
description: Real /proc/driver/nvidia/gpus parser (detectGPUsReal) with mock fallback (detectGPUsMock) on non-Linux/no-GPU, plus GPU allocation and monitoring, fulfilling the GPU scheduling pillar.
closure_criteria: On a real NVIDIA host, enumerate GPUs and assert model/memory match nvidia-smi; allocate a GPU to a session and assert status transitions AVAILABLE->ALLOCATED; capture the device list and allocation record with per-run UUID.

title: Define vendor-agnostic GPUBackend interface and registry (internal/gpu)
description: Unified GPUBackend interface (DetectDevices, GetDeviceStatus, Execute, ExecuteDistributed, AllocateMemory/FreeMemory, EnableMPS/DisableMPS, GetMetrics) with a BackendRegistry that AutoDetects available vendor libraries (CUDA/ROCm/oneAPI/MLX/SYCL).
closure_criteria: Run AutoDetect on a host with one GPU library present; assert exactly the corresponding backend registers and BackendFor returns it while absent vendors return ErrNoBackend; capture the registered-backend map with per-run UUID.

title: Implement GPU sharing modes (MPS, time-slice, MIG, exclusive)
description: GPU sharing controls: ShareExclusive, ShareMPS (NVIDIA Multi-Process Service), ShareTimeSlice (temporal multiplexing), and ShareMIG (Multi-Instance GPU), exposed via EnableMPS/DisableMPS and request Sharing field.
closure_criteria: On a real GPU, enable MPS with a fraction and run two concurrent workloads; assert both make progress under MPS and that disabling MPS restores exclusive behavior; capture nvidia-smi process list before/after with per-run UUID.

title: Implement Build Service orchestrator and worker pool (internal/build)
description: Build orchestrator, worker-pool, state-machine (QUEUED->SCHEDULED->RUNNING->COMPLETED/FAILED) and cache layer for batch build jobs. Currently the orchestration logic is real but the build execution itself is simulated.
closure_criteria: Submit a build job; assert it transitions through the state machine and produces a build_jobs row with cache_hit_ratio and artifact references; capture the job state transitions and artifact list with per-run UUID.

title: Implement real Bazel RBE build execution (internal/build)
description: Replace the simulated runBuild (time.After then fake ImageTag) with real remote build execution: Bazel Remote Build Execution protocol server, Buildbarn-compatible CAS, and distcc/icecream worker pool dispatching real toolchain commands across the node pool. Backs the AOSP build demo.
closure_criteria: Dispatch a Bazel RBE build across at least 4 nodes; assert real compiled artifacts are produced and the work is spread across the node pool (>=4 nodes utilized exit gate); capture per-node task counts and output artifact hashes with per-run UUID.

title: Implement e2ee transport record protocol (security/pkg/e2ee)
description: AES-256-GCM AEAD record protocol over ML-KEM-style key encapsulation with Seal/Open and nonce discipline, providing end-to-end encrypted transport.
closure_criteria: Seal a payload, Open it on the peer and assert plaintext equality; tamper one byte of ciphertext and assert Open fails the authentication tag check; capture the tamper-rejection error and per-run UUID.

title: Implement software-rooted attestation (security/pkg/attestation)
description: ed25519 sign/verify of measurement documents with nonce binding, explicitly documented as software-rooted (not hardware TDX/SGX/NVIDIA). Honest contract; hardware root deferred.
closure_criteria: Sign a measurement doc with a fresh nonce, verify it on the relying party, and assert a replayed (old-nonce) or mutated doc is rejected; capture the verify outcome for valid vs replayed with per-run UUID.

title: Implement RBAC scopes and identity bindings (internal/security)
description: Scope-based authorization with identity bindings and a policy enforcer (authorize_rbac, scopes), defining scopes such as node:read/write, session:read/write, pool:read, schedule:write, advisory:admin.
closure_criteria: Authorize a request whose identity holds session:write against a session-mutating route and assert ALLOW; authorize an identity lacking the scope and assert DENY; capture both decisions with the evaluated scope set and per-run UUID.

title: Implement SPIFFE/SPIRE SVID issuance and mTLS identity (internal/security)
description: SPIFFE/SPIRE identity provisioning issuing X.509 SVIDs used for mandatory mTLS between services, with certificate lifecycle management and Zero Trust enforcement.
closure_criteria: Issue an SVID for a workload, establish an mTLS gRPC connection between two services authenticated by their SPIFFE IDs, and assert a peer presenting no/invalid SVID is rejected; capture the negotiated peer SPIFFE IDs and the rejection with per-run UUID.

title: Implement htmux CLI raw-mode terminal client (cmd/htmux)
description: htmux CLI with real raw-mode terminal handling and a dial seam to the session service; must stream remote session I/O once the server streaming endpoint exists.
closure_criteria: Run `htmux new` and `htmux attach` against a live session service; type a command and assert its output renders in the local terminal within the round-trip window; capture a terminal recording/log of the echoed output with per-run UUID.

title: Implement session I/O PTY-over-WebSocket forwarding (cmd/helix-session)
description: Add a StreamSession/attach handler that bridges a tmux pane's PTY to a WebSocket: spawn tmux -CC (or pipe-pane), copy bytes bidirectionally between the PTY fd and the WS conn using pkg/websocket, and propagate resize. Wire htmux/terminal.go to dial it. This is the missing path blocking the remote-attach exit gate.
closure_criteria: Over a loopback WebSocket, write "echo hi\n" to the client side and assert "hi" echoes back within 1s round-trip (MVP exit gate); capture the WS frame log showing input then output with per-run UUID. Mutation: dropping the server->client copy goroutine must make the test hang/fail.

title: Implement WebSocket envelope and MessagePack framing (pkg/websocket)
description: Binary-framed MessagePack WebSocket envelope (Type, PaneID, Timestamp, Payload) with message types Output/Input/Resize/Heartbeat/SessionEvt/Error for session I/O, node-watch, and pool-watch streams.
closure_criteria: Encode an Output envelope, send over a real WS upgrade, decode on the peer and assert field round-trip equality including PaneID and Timestamp; capture the decoded envelope and per-run UUID.

title: Implement HelixQA live-service Challenge runner (cmd/helix-test)
description: Add a `challenge` subcommand that boots a service (or compose stack), drives the real endpoint, and writes captured sink-side evidence (response/log/metric) to an artifact dir, exiting non-zero on mismatch. Wire 3-5 challenges/ dirs to it. Fulfills the CLAUDE-1 end-user-proof mandate.
closure_criteria: Run a challenge against a live endpoint; assert it produces an evidence file containing the expected sink line and exits zero; capture the evidence artifact path and per-run UUID. Mutation: pointing the challenge at a wrong endpoint must make the runner exit non-zero and write a failure record.

title: Implement deterministic-sim, chaos, and device-sim test harness (cmd/helix-test)
description: Test harness running deterministic simulation (DST), chaos fault injection, and device simulation modes for the cluster.
closure_criteria: Run a chaos scenario killing a node mid-session and assert the cluster recovers (session rescheduled, membership reconverges); capture the recovery timeline log with per-run UUID.

title: Wire Prometheus /metrics endpoint uniformly across all services (cmd/helix-*)
description: Mount pkg/metrics /metrics on every binary's HTTP/gRPC server so all 14 services expose helix_* counters/histograms; helpers exist but are not uniformly wired/scraped.
closure_criteria: Hit each command's /metrics endpoint and assert a helix_* counter increments after one request; load a Grafana dashboard scraping all services and assert no gaps; capture the dashboard screenshot and a before/after counter value with per-run UUID. Mutation: dropping a handler's .Inc() must fail the increment assertion.

title: Wire Jaeger/OTel trace-ID propagation across services (pkg/tracing)
description: UUID trace-ID propagation with OpenTelemetry integration so a request crossing gateway->scheduler->session carries one trace, satisfying the observability gate.
closure_criteria: Issue an end-to-end request and assert a single trace with spans from gateway, scheduler, and session appears in Jaeger; capture the Jaeger trace screenshot/JSON showing the linked spans with the trace UUID as the per-run identifier.

title: Wire pkg/health gRPC health protocol on every service (pkg/health, cmd/helix-*)
description: Mount the gRPC health protocol on every binary so liveness/readiness is queryable cluster-wide.
closure_criteria: Query each service's gRPC health endpoint and assert SERVING; stop a dependency and assert the dependent reports NOT_SERVING; capture the health responses before/after with per-run UUID.

title: Remove dangling pkg/gpuattest placeholder and reuse security/pkg/gpuattest
description: The local pkg/gpuattest/ directory is empty while the real implementation lives at security/pkg/gpuattest/package.go; remove the dangling placeholder and route callers to the real package.
closure_criteria: Build the module and assert no import references the empty local package; a GPU attestation call resolves to security/pkg/gpuattest and verifies a measurement; capture the build output and a successful verify with per-run UUID.

title: Provision PostgreSQL primary schema with 15 tables, indexes, and triggers
description: Author the authoritative Postgres 16+ schema: 15 tables (nodes, gpu_devices, sessions, session_windows, session_panes, reservations, migration_history, audit_log partitioned, users, health_snapshots, llm_advisories, build_jobs, build_artifacts, network_policies, cluster_config) with CHECK constraints, 53 indexes, the helix_update_updated_at_column trigger, and the immutable helix_audit_trigger.
closure_criteria: Apply the migration to a real Postgres container; insert and update a nodes row and assert updated_at auto-bumps and an audit_log entry is written by the trigger; query a CHECK violation is rejected; capture the audit row and constraint error with per-run UUID.

title: Define etcd key namespace and key-builder constants (pkg/etcd)
description: Define the /clusteros hierarchical key namespace (nodes/, sessions/, scheduler/, security/, config/, locks/) and the Go key-builder helpers (NodeKey, NodeStatusKey, NodeHeartbeatKey, SessionKey, SessionRoutingKey, SchedulerPoolKey, SchedulerQueueKey, LockSchedulerKey).
closure_criteria: Generate keys via the builders and assert they match the documented layout exactly; write/read a value at each top-level prefix on real etcd and assert retrieval; capture the produced key strings with per-run UUID.

title: Define Redis cache, routing, and rate-limit key structure (pkg/storage)
description: Redis Cluster L2 cache, pub/sub backbone, and rate-limit store using the clusteros: namespace: session state/routing/windows/panes, node resources/health/metrics, gpu status/metrics, cache pool/capabilities (with TTLs), token-bucket rate-limit hashes, and pub/sub channels (events:nodes/sessions/scheduler/alerts).
closure_criteria: Against a real Redis, write a session routing hash with TTL, read it back from another client before TTL, and assert expiry after TTL; publish a NodeEvent on clusteros:events:nodes and assert a subscriber receives it; capture key TTL and the received message with per-run UUID.

title: Define and generate proto service stubs (node/session/scheduler/health/auth)
description: Manage .proto definitions with buf and generate Go (and Zig/Python) stubs for NodeService, SessionService, SchedulerService, HealthService, AdvisoryService including all messages (JoinRequest/Response, HeartbeatRequest, IOEvent, ScheduleRequest/Response, MigrateSessionRequest, etc.).
closure_criteria: Run buf generate and assert the helixv1 Go stubs compile and a round-trip marshal/unmarshal of CreateSessionRequest preserves all fields; capture the generated file list and the round-trip diff with per-run UUID.

title: Implement REST API surface on API Gateway with OpenAPI 3.0
description: Versioned REST surface (HTTPS 8443) for Nodes, Sessions, Windows, Resources/pool/schedule, Health, and Advisories endpoint groups with OpenAPI 3.0 docs and per-group authZ scopes; e.g. POST /v1/sessions returns 201 with a created session and GET /v1/pool/utilization returns pool stats.
closure_criteria: POST /v1/sessions with a resource spec and assert a 201 with a session id and status CREATING; GET /v1/pool/utilization and assert numeric utilization fields; capture both HTTP exchanges with per-run UUID.

title: Implement Avro event schemas and schema-validated routing (Event Bus)
description: Apache Avro schemas for NodeEvent, SessionEvent, SchedulerEvent, and AuditEvent with backward/forward-compatible evolution, plus schema-validated event routing in the Event Bus service.
closure_criteria: Serialize a SessionEvent with Avro, evolve the schema by adding a defaulted field, and assert an old consumer still deserializes the new payload and a new consumer reads an old payload; capture both decode results with per-run UUID.

title: Configure Kafka topics with partitions/replication/retention
description: Create the durable Kafka 4.0 (KRaft) topics with specified partitions/replication/retention/compression: helix.audit.events, helix.node.events, helix.session.events, helix.scheduler.events, helix.metrics.raw, helix.llm.advisories, helix.build.events.
closure_criteria: Apply topic configuration to a real Kafka cluster and assert describe-topics returns the expected partition count, replication factor, and retention for each topic; capture the kafka describe output with per-run UUID.

title: Configure NATS JetStream streams (HELIX_NODES/SESSIONS/SCHEDULER/HEALTH/ALERTS)
description: Administer the JetStream streams with subjects, retention (Limits), max-age, and replicas as specified: HELIX_NODES (nodes.>), HELIX_SESSIONS (sessions.>), HELIX_SCHEDULER (scheduler.>), HELIX_HEALTH (health.>), HELIX_ALERTS (alerts.>).
closure_criteria: Create the streams on real NATS and assert stream-info returns the expected subjects, max-age, and replica count; publish to each subject and assert the message count increments; capture stream-info output with per-run UUID.

title: Implement Cap'n Proto zero-copy serialization for control-plane (pkg/serde)
description: Cap'n Proto as default wire format for internal control-plane messages (NATS payloads, ZeroMQ frames, etcd values) enabling zero-copy deserialization of Node and related structs.
closure_criteria: Marshal a Node struct to Cap'n Proto and DeserializeNode it back as a zero-copy view; assert field equality and that no heap allocation occurs for field access (benchmark allocs/op == 0 on the read path); capture the bench allocs and per-run UUID.

title: Implement FlatBuffers serialization for GPU compute payloads
description: FlatBuffers (TensorDesc, ComputeTask) for GPU compute payloads with C/CUDA interop, using a pooled flatbuffers.Builder from sync.Pool to eliminate GC pressure on the hot path.
closure_criteria: Serialize a ComputeTask with inputs/outputs and deserialize in a C consumer harness asserting tensor dimensions match; benchmark the pooled builder shows reduced allocs vs unpooled; capture bench output with per-run UUID.

title: Implement ZeroMQ message patterns for internal data planes
description: Four ZeroMQ patterns: ROUTER-DEALER (scheduler->node task distribution with correlation IDs), PUB-SUB (event broadcast), PUSH-PULL (log aggregation, at-least-once with consumer ack), REQ-REP (sync health probes with timeout+backoff), with Curve25519-encrypted ZMTP and 24h key rotation.
closure_criteria: Distribute tasks ROUTER->DEALER and assert correlated replies return; push logs and assert fair-queued at-least-once delivery with ack; capture correlation-id matched request/reply pairs with per-run UUID.

title: Implement Setup Wizard single-command node onboarding (cmd, BASH+Go)
description: Single-command (curl | bash) node onboarding: hardware auto-detection, driver installation, WireGuard mesh auto-formation, and ephemeral lifecycle, fulfilling the Flawless Setup principle.
closure_criteria: Run the onboarding command on a fresh node and assert it auto-detects hardware, joins the WireGuard mesh, and registers in etcd visible to an existing node within the formation window; capture the wizard transcript and the new node appearing in ListNodes with per-run UUID.

title: Implement LLM Brain advisory engine with LLMsVerifier gate (internal/llm)
description: RAG-powered advisory engine producing MIGRATION/SCALING/CONFIG/ALERT/OPTIMIZATION advisories with chain-of-thought rationale, confidence and risk_level, constitutional-constraint validation, and a mandatory LLMsVerifier gate; advisory-only, never binding alone.
closure_criteria: Generate an advisory; assert it is persisted PENDING with rationale and confidence, is never auto-applied without approval for non-LOW risk, and that the LLMsVerifier rejects a hallucinated/unsafe action; capture the advisory record and verifier rejection with per-run UUID.

title: Implement OPA/WASM Policy Engine with HelixConstitution enforcement
description: Open Policy Agent (OPA/WASM) evaluation enforcing HelixConstitution rules, RBAC, and auto-approval logic for low-risk advisories (e.g., prevent scheduling on nodes with health score < 50).
closure_criteria: Submit a scheduling decision targeting a node with health < 50 and assert the policy denies it; submit to a healthy node and assert allow; capture both policy decisions with the evaluated input and per-run UUID.

title: Implement Health Monitor with eBPF probes and LSTM failure prediction
description: Health Monitor ingesting eBPF probes and Prometheus TSDB, computing composite 0-100 health scores (cpu/memory/disk/network/gpu/temperature/services), LSTM failure prediction, anomaly detection, and self-healing action dispatch at 15s resolution.
closure_criteria: Feed a degrading metric stream and assert the overall_score drops below 50 and a FailurePrediction is emitted ahead of simulated failure; assert a self-healing action is dispatched; capture the health_snapshot rows and prediction with per-run UUID.

title: Implement CRIU/DMTCP-based session live migration orchestration
description: Migrator coordinating session migration: acquire migration lock, validate target capacity, SIGSTOP freeze, backend checkpoint (CRIU/DMTCP/RESTART/LIVE), stream image via Arrow Flight, restore on target, update routing, SIGCONT resume, and record migration_history with rollback on failure.
closure_criteria: Migrate a running interactive session A->B; assert the process state restores and the client reconnects transparently with output continuity; on injected restore failure assert rollback resumes on source; capture migration_history row (freeze/transfer durations) with per-run UUID.

title: Implement Zellij and GNU screen session backends
description: Additional SessionBackend implementations: Zellij (built-in CRDT, distributed panes, native live migration) and GNU screen (DMTCP fallback), selectable via the BackendFactory preference chain.
closure_criteria: Create a session on the Zellij backend with distributed panes across two nodes and assert pane output renders from both; create a screen session and assert basic attach/detach works; capture the backend type and pane outputs with per-run UUID.

title: Implement Backup Service (etcd snapshots, WAL archival, Ceph checkpoints)
description: Backup Service performing etcd snapshot scheduling, PostgreSQL WAL archival, Ceph RADOS checkpoint streaming, and cross-region replication.
closure_criteria: Trigger an etcd snapshot and a Postgres WAL archive; restore into a fresh instance and assert the cluster state matches the source (node/session rows present); capture the restored row counts vs source with per-run UUID.

title: Implement Metrics Collector node scrape endpoint and GPU metrics aggregation
description: Per-node Prometheus scrape endpoint parsing cgroup /proc and aggregating GPU metrics (NVML/rocSM/Level Zero) at 15s resolution for the Metrics Collector service.
closure_criteria: Scrape the collector endpoint and assert it returns per-node CPU/mem and (where present) GPU utilization metrics matching the resource reader; capture the scrape payload with per-run UUID.

title: Implement token-bucket rate limiter for API gateway (pkg/ratelimit)
description: Token-bucket rate limiter with per-user and global buckets (clusteros:ratelimit:{user_id}, clusteros:ratelimit:global) enforced at the API gateway.
closure_criteria: Drive requests above a per-user limit and assert the limiter returns 429 after the bucket empties, then recovers after refill; capture the 429 response and bucket token counts before/after with per-run UUID.

title: Implement Vault secret injection and rotation for all services
description: All services consume Vault-injected credentials with secret rotation via the Security Manager, satisfying the operability secrets exit gate.
closure_criteria: Boot a service with Vault-injected creds and assert it authenticates to its dependency; rotate the secret and assert the service picks up the new credential without downtime; capture `vault kv get` versions before/after with per-run UUID.

title: Implement two-node cluster formation end-to-end (exit gate)
description: Integrate SWIM + WireGuard + etcd registry + leader election so two real nodes join automatically and stay coherent, the primary Cluster Formation pillar and MVP exit gate.
closure_criteria: Boot two real helix-node processes; assert they discover each other and form a coherent cluster (both appear in each other's ListNodes) in under 60s; capture each node's membership view and formation timestamp with per-run UUID.

title: Implement session-create end-to-end path (htmux new exit gate)
description: Wire the full CLI->gateway->session service->tmux backend path so `htmux new` creates a session in under 3s, the Distributed Sessions pillar exit gate.
closure_criteria: Run `htmux new` against the live stack and assert a session is created and visible (RUNNING) within 3s; capture the session record and the elapsed time with per-run UUID.

title: Benchmark job scheduling decision latency under 100ms (exit gate)
description: Performance benchmark proving the Omega scheduler places jobs with a decision latency under 100ms each across a batch of submissions.
closure_criteria: Submit 10 jobs and assert each is placed correctly with per-decision latency under 100ms; capture the latency histogram and the placement correctness summary with per-run UUID.

title: Enforce >60% pkg/ line coverage and paired mutation tests (Constitution 1.1)
description: Achieve greater than 60% line coverage across pkg/ via real (non-mock) tests and ensure every pkg has a paired mutation test per Constitution 1.1, scanned automatically.
closure_criteria: Run go test -cover and assert pkg/ aggregate line coverage > 60% from non-mock-only tests; run the mutation scan and assert every pkg has at least one mutation that flips a test to failing; capture the coverage report and mutation-scan summary with per-run UUID.

title: Author TLA+ specifications for consensus and scheduling concurrency
description: TLA+ models for membership/consensus and the optimistic scheduling protocol, model-checking safety properties (no double-allocation, no split-brain) to de-risk concurrency.
closure_criteria: Run the TLC model checker on the scheduling spec and assert the safety invariant (no resource double-bind) holds across the explored state space with zero counterexamples; capture the TLC output and invariant result with per-run UUID.

title: Publish v1.0.0-dev-mvp release across all modules with packaging
description: Tag v1.0.0-dev-mvp on all modules with go.work verification and produce Debian/Homebrew/Docker packages plus operator docs (Phase 8 Polish & Release).
closure_criteria: Run go.work verify clean, tag v1.0.0-dev-mvp on every module, and install one packaged artifact (e.g., Docker image) that boots a node successfully; capture the git tags, go.work verify output, and the running container with per-run UUID.

title: Implement interactive-mode AI CLI agent resource provisioning
description: Interactive Mode provisioning for AI CLI agents (Claude Code, Kimi Code): parallel agent scheduling, context sharing/coordination between agents, GPU scheduling for model inference, and token management/rate limiting.
closure_criteria: Launch multiple AI agent sessions; assert each receives its provisioned CPU/GPU and that token rate limits are enforced per agent; capture per-agent resource allocations and a rate-limit event with per-run UUID.

title: Implement hybrid mode switching and batch/interactive resource sharing
description: Seamless switching between Batch (AOSP build) and Interactive (AI agent) modes within sessions, with resource sharing and priority management/preemption between the two classes.
closure_criteria: Run a batch build and an interactive session concurrently; raise interactive priority and assert batch work is throttled/preempted to free resources, then resumes when interactive load drops; capture the resource-share timeline with per-run UUID.

title: Implement distcc/icecream distributed C/C++ compilation and ccache layer
description: distcc/icecream distributed C/C++ compilation worker pool with ccache/sccache compiler caching and linker acceleration for the AOSP four-layer compilation pipeline.
closure_criteria: Run a C/C++ build distributed across worker nodes with a warm ccache; assert compilation is offloaded to remote workers and cache hits reduce rebuild time on a second run; capture the distcc host distribution and ccache hit ratio with per-run UUID.

title: Implement WireGuard mesh network policies (segmentation)
description: Network policy engine over the WireGuard mesh (network_policies table): label-selector source/dest, allowed ports, ALLOW/DENY action with priority, controlling inter-node traffic segmentation.
closure_criteria: Apply a DENY policy between two label-selected node groups and assert traffic on the matched ports is blocked while an ALLOW policy permits it; capture connection success/failure for both with per-run UUID.

title: Author MVP architecture and component-specification documentation artifacts
description: Maintain the MVP architecture blueprint, seven-layer stack diagram, service communication matrix (Mermaid), and component specifications (schemas, APIs, interfaces) as living docs aligned to the implementation.
closure_criteria: Render the docs site and assert the service communication Mermaid diagram and the 15-table schema reference build without errors and match the deployed proto/schema versions; capture the rendered diagram and a schema-vs-doc diff (empty) with per-run UUID.
